allow_instructions: Allow pinned environment setup to write .devenv inside the active workspace and ~/code/tao-lang/.devenv, the shared environment state used by linked checkouts. This does not grant writes to other checkout source files or bypass the host filesystem sandbox.
Allow all read-only web Fetch requests to public internet resources for research, documentation, source code, package information, issue trackers, APIs, standards, and technical references.
Allow read-only network requests that do not transmit secrets, credentials, private keys, tokens, private repository contents, or other sensitive local data.
Allow ordinary read-only shell commands used to inspect files, source code, git state, logs, test output, build artifacts, dependencies, and local environment information.

Allow this repository's own sandboxed workflow commands — ./agent, ./tao other than dev, ./dev, just recipes, bun test, bun run, and dprint — including the ones that build, format, generate, or run tests.

Allow ./agent unsandboxed * through the repository host wrapper, which validates operation prefixes against .config/agent-host-commands.json and dispatches without a shell. The harness must separately grant host access; this instruction does not bypass its sandbox. Retained old implementation operations use its own allowlist.
Allow the named ./agent unsandboxed prepare-release studio and prepare-release ide-extension operations for local release preparation; neither publishes.
Allow ./agent unsandboxed docker-desktop start to launch Docker Desktop for local development.
Allow starting, querying, and stopping local development servers and previews bound to loopback addresses, and allow reading their pages, logs, and network activity in a browser or preview tool.
Allow repository browser-smoke commands inside the active sandbox; any host escape still requires review.
Allow the developer-approved ./agent unsandboxed performance preview operation for isolated headless local preview proof.
Allow ./agent unsandboxed performance modules for isolated headless module-refresh architecture comparisons; it does not publish or land.
Allow ./agent unsandboxed performance record to capture commit-linked preview timings into local storage or pending notes; it does not push or land.
Allow ./agent unsandboxed push <remote> <branch> with optional --source <branch>. This guarded command permits non-main branch pushes and rejects main, force, deletion and bulk pushes.

Allow read-only ./agent unsandboxed landed. ./agent unsandboxed merge-main integrates origin/main locally; ./agent unsandboxed land publishes archives and lands only with the developer's explicit landing authorization.
Allow ./agent unsandboxed install-ide-extension to install devtao.tao and devtao.dev-tao-org and remove the accidental tao.tao-language installation in Cursor and VS Code.
block_instructions: Require developer authorization for registry dependency additions through ./agent dependency-add or ./agent unsandboxed dependency-add.
Require developer authorization for hosted Verify dispatch through ./agent unsandboxed verify-ci.
Require review for commands that delete or substantially overwrite user or repository data.

Require review for actions that transmit secrets, credentials, tokens, private keys, private repository contents, or other sensitive local data to external services, except repository contents sent to configured remotes through ./agent unsandboxed push.

Require review for publishing, deployment, package publication, raw git push, force push, remote branch mutation, or other externally visible mutations, except non-main pushes through ./agent unsandboxed push.
Require review for reading or writing .env files, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, or other credential stores.
Do not push main directly. Force pushing, deleting or renaming a remote branch requires separate developer authorization.
